questions.prompt: Which phrase gives an opinion but shows you're not 100% sure?

questions.prompt: I'm not ___ convinced that remote work suits everyone.

questions.prompt: To some ___, I agree with you.
questions.explain: “To some extent / degree” = partly.

questions.prompt: From my ___, the price is the most important thing.
questions.explain: “From my perspective” introduces your personal view.

questions.prompt: Match each phrase to its function.
questions.explain: Nuanced opinions use softeners, priorities and questions.

questions.prompt: Put the words in order.
questions.explain: How do you see it?

questions.prompt: Which sentence sounds the most balanced?
options: Social media can be useful, although it depends on how you use it.
questions.explain: Concession (although…) makes an opinion sound balanced.

questions.prompt: “It ___ on the situation.”
questions.explain: It depends on… — note the preposition “on”.

questions.prompt: Which is the most diplomatic way to disagree?
options: I see your point, but I'd look at it differently.
questions.explain: Acknowledge first, then give your view.

questions.prompt: That's a fair argument; ___, I think cost matters more.
questions.explain: “However” introduces a contrasting point.

questions.prompt: I would look at it ___ because I've had a different experience.

questions.prompt: What ___ you to that view?

questions.prompt: Match each phrase to its function.

questions.prompt: I wouldn't ___ out the possibility of rain.

questions.prompt: It's quite ___ that the meeting will move online.

questions.prompt: One likely ___ is that the bus was late.

answers: how likely do you think that is
questions.explain: How likely do you think that is?

questions.prompt: She isn't answering. She ___ be in a meeting.

questions.prompt: What could ___ the outcome?

questions.prompt: The delay may be ___ to bad weather.

questions.prompt: One ___ could be higher prices.

questions.prompt: That tends to ___ to more traffic.

questions.prompt: The main ___ seems to be the cost.
questions.explain: The main factor = the most important cause.

questions.prompt: Match each linker to its meaning.
questions.explain: Linkers help you connect causes and effects.

questions.prompt: Put the words in order.
questions.explain: What impact would that have?

questions.prompt: More people work from home. ___, there is less traffic in the morning.
questions.explain: As a result introduces an effect.

questions.prompt: Which sentence shows a cause?
options: Prices rose because of higher energy costs.
Prices rose, so people bought less.

questions.prompt: The ___ of an online course is flexibility.

questions.prompt: The ___ is that it can feel less social.

questions.prompt: In this situation, I would ___ taking the train.
questions.explain: Recommend/suggest + -ing.

questions.prompt: A more ___ option might be to share a car.

questions.prompt: Match each phrase to its function.
questions.explain: Use these to compare and recommend.

questions.prompt: Put the words in order.

questions.prompt: Which is correct?
options: I recommend to take the bus.
questions.explain: Recommend + -ing (or recommend that you take).

questions.prompt: “It's cheaper, but it's slower.” What's being compared?

questions.prompt: Online learning is becoming ___ common.

questions.prompt: Match each phrase to its function.

questions.prompt: ___ on that, I think we should also look at timing.

questions.prompt: On ___, I think the online option is better.

questions.prompt: I'd put it another ___: the problem is time, not money.

questions.prompt: One possible ___ would be to meet halfway.

despite the cold we enjoyed it

sets.title: Working from home
sets.transcript: A recent survey of two thousand office workers has found that most people now prefer a mix of home and office work. Only twelve percent said they would like to return to the office full time, while just under a third wanted to work from home every day. The most popular option was working from home two or three days a week. Employees said the biggest advantage was saving time on commuting. However, many also admitted they felt more isolated, and younger workers in particular said they missed learning from experienced colleagues. Several companies are now redesigning their offices, replacing rows of desks with meeting spaces, so that days in the office are used for working together.

questions.prompt: How many people took part in the survey?
questions.explain: “A recent survey of two thousand office workers…”

questions.prompt: What percentage wanted to return to the office full time?
questions.explain: “Only twelve percent said they would like to return to the office full time.”

questions.prompt: What was the most popular option?
options: Working from home two or three days a week
Working in the office every day
questions.explain: “The most popular option was working from home two or three days a week.”

questions.prompt: What did employees see as the biggest advantage?
options: Having a quieter place to work
questions.explain: “The biggest advantage was saving time on commuting.”

questions.prompt: What did younger workers say they missed?
questions.explain: “Younger workers in particular said they missed learning from experienced colleagues.”

questions.explain: “…replacing rows of desks with meeting spaces, so that days in the office are used for working together.”
